title: Change the default timeout in a densely repeated config
description: app/config.py contains several similar-looking timeout settings. Change only DEFAULT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT from 30 to 60, leaving every other timeout untouched. This task deliberately contains near-duplicate lines to exercise precise patching.
acceptanceCriteria: All other timeout values are unchanged
brief: A small Python service configuration module.

seedFiles.app/config.py:
"""Service configuration."""

DEFAULT_CONNECT_TIMEOUT = 30
DEFAULT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT = 30
DEFAULT_READ_TIMEOUT = 30
DEFAULT_WRITE_TIMEOUT = 30
DEFAULT_POOL_TIMEOUT = 30
seedFiles.test_config.py:
from app import config


def test_request_timeout_updated():
    assert config.DEFAULT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT == 60


def test_others_unchanged():
    assert config.DEFAULT_CONNECT_TIMEOUT == 30
    assert config.DEFAULT_READ_TIMEOUT == 30
    assert config.DEFAULT_WRITE_TIMEOUT == 30
    assert config.DEFAULT_POOL_TIMEOUT == 30
